text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...
Out of all races, not this one~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Out of place...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: It doesn't suit me...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's way too much of an afterthought!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Japanese Derby. The most prestigious and special race among the Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle had built up a decent track record,
but...
She did nothing but flinch before the big race.
choice_data_list: Isn't calling it a bonus a bit much?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no matter how you look at it,
it's just a freebie~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's like I don't belong here, you know?
I just can't settle down.
I've been fidgeting the whole time.
choice_data_list: Still, it's a huge honor, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah... I know that, but still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I gotta go soon.
Wait, which door, which door, which one...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right...
*sway, sway, sway*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With her mind clearly elsewhere, Hishi Miracle drifted toward the paddock with unsteady, floaty steps.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And here it is, the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The center of attention is undeniably these two,
whose sheer competitive drive on the track is on another level."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The God of Destruction, Tanino Gimlet,
and the consummate professional, Symboli Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
On one hand, an Umamusume of dynamic motion, and on the other, one of calm precision!
Yet neither yields an inch in their running!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh, after the 'NHK Mile Cup', this is the next stop, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll kick right through it.
Uprooting every single theorem along the way.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Come, Kris S. Let's see if your dagger's blade can pierce a towering tree!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Japanese Derby'.
A glory unseen since Rudolf and Sirius..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you.
—I will achieve it, by surpassing you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, should I say something? Give a greeting?
Like a 'hello' to Gimlet-chan and Kris S-chan~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm just watching, just watching... Won't get in the way.
Think of it as a cameo appearance from me.
